tools.name: init
tools.description: Setup or create a project that includes Primer React

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List all of the components available from Primer React

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Retrieve official documentation and usage details for exactly one React component from the @primer/react package. Use get_component_batch for 2 to 10 components.

name.description: The name of the component to retrieve

tools.name: get_component_batch
tools.description: Retrieve official documentation and usage details for 2 to 10 React components from the @primer/react package in one call. Use get_component for exactly one component.

tools.name: get_component_examples
tools.description: Get examples for how to use a component from Primer React

name.description: The name of the component to retrieve

tools.name: get_component_usage_guidelines
tools.description: Get usage information for how to use a component from Primer

name.description: The name of the component to retrieve

tools.name: get_component_accessibility_guidelines
tools.description: Retrieve accessibility guidelines and best practices for a specific component from the @primer/react package by its name. Use this tool to get official accessibility recommendations, usage tips, and requirements to ensure your UI components are inclusive and meet accessibility standards.

name.description: The name of the component to retrieve

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List all of the patterns available from Primer React. Scenario patterns describe specific user tasks. Prefer a scenario pattern when one fits the task, and fall back to the more generic UI patterns otherwise.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Get a specific pattern by name. Scenario patterns describe specific user tasks. Prefer a scenario pattern when one fits the task, and fall back to the more generic UI patterns otherwise.

name.description: The name of the pattern to retrieve

tools.name: find_tokens
tools.description: Search for specific tokens. Tip: If you only provide a 'group' and leave 'query' empty, it returns all tokens in that category. Avoid property-by-property searching. COLOR RESOLUTION: If a user asks for "pink" or "blue", do not search for the color name. Use the semantic intent: blue->accent, red->danger, green->success. Always check both "emphasis" and "muted" variants for background colors. After identifying tokens and writing CSS, you MUST validate the result using lint_css.

limit.description: Maximum results to return to stay within context limits

tools.name: get_token_group_bundle
tools.description: PREFERRED FOR COMPONENTS. Fetch all tokens for complex UI (e.g., Dialogs, Cards) in one call by providing an array of groups like ['overlay', 'shadow']. Use this instead of multiple find_tokens calls to save context.

tools.name: get_design_token_specs
tools.description: CRITICAL: CALL THIS FIRST. Provides the logic matrix and the list of valid group names. You cannot search accurately without this map.

tools.name: get_token_usage_patterns
tools.description: Provides "Golden Example" CSS for core patterns: Button (Interactions) and Stack (Layout). Use this to understand how to apply the Logic Matrix, Motion, and Spacing scales.

tools.name: lint_css
tools.description: REQUIRED FINAL STEP. Use this to validate your CSS. You cannot complete a task involving CSS without a successful run of this tool.

tools.name: get_color_usage
tools.description: Get the guidelines for how to apply color to a user interface

tools.name: get_typography_usage
tools.description: Get the guidelines for how to apply typography to a user interface

tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: List all of the icons (octicons) available from Primer Octicons React

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: Get a specific icon (octicon) by name from Primer

name.description: The name of the icon to retrieve

size.description: The size of the icon to retrieve, e.g. "16"

tools.name: primer_coding_guidelines
tools.description: Get the guidelines when writing code that uses Primer or for UI code that you are creating

tools.name: review_alt_text
tools.description: Evaluates image alt text against accessibility best practices and context relevance.

surroundingText.description: Text surrounding the image, relevant to the image.

alt.description: The alt text of the image being evaluated

image.description: The image URL or file path being evaluated
